name: Fidel Castro
role: Cuban revolutionary, prime minister (1959–1976) and president (1976–2008)
summary: Castro defended a socialist economy and Communist Party government, with universal public education and health services. He promoted anti-imperialist solidarity and redistribution internationally, and in later life emphasised ecological survival while condemning earlier persecution of gay Cubans.

Pass of 2026-11-16 (rules 7): answers where a record exists (1976 constitution, Human Rights Watch 1999 report, reports of the Angola deployment) were re-sourced to the record and the earlier words-based or Wikipedia-only versions kept in reviewHistory. Themes searched: economy, government and elections, courts, religion, equality, labour, world and war, colonialism, population. The criminalize-homosexuality answer still rests on his 2010 words; the record on it (UMAP camps, 1979 penal code) is not cited. Two texts were not retrieved (see notFound).
